notes.title: Developer Update: Economy and Progression
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190071/6a16904b29ae7f0771809eac53e62ca7299da396.png"]

Pilots, thank you for your continued support and patience as we shape the future of War Robots: Frontiers.

Over the past few months, we've been carefully planning how new robots and weapons are introduced into the game. We know how important it is to maintain a fair, transparent, and enjoyable experience for all players, especially as the battlefield evolves with new content.

With that in mind, we want to take a moment to share how new content will be handled moving forward. Our goal is to keep things clear and consistent for every pilot, whether you're just starting out or deep into your journey.

So, here’s what’s changing, and how we plan to introduce new gear in a way that supports a healthy game economy and progression system.
How New Robots and Weapons Will Be Released 
Our goal is to give you early access opportunities while ensuring that new content gradually becomes accessible to players through regular gameplay. 

First, new robots and weapons will debut through limited-time direct sales (including Daily Deals). These offers will be available for a short period and are designed for players who want to get their hands on the latest tech right away.

Next, they’ll be featured in an upcoming Battle Pass or Event Pass. This gives players another chance to earn them through gameplay while also enjoying seasonal content and rewards.
What’s Coming Next
We know many of you are eager to plan ahead, so here’s a look at the upcoming content schedule and what to expect in the weeks ahead.

September 23–30 – The limited-time sale for the new Kumo War Robot is live! This is your first chance to deploy Kumo on the battlefield. But don’t worry if you miss it—Kumo will be making its way into the Battle Pass starting October 14.

October 14 – Season 3 begins, and with it comes a wave of new content. Throughout the season, we’ll be introducing new spider-type robots and weapons, each bringing unique abilities and playstyles to shake up the meta. We’ll share more details about each addition as they’re released, so stay tuned for regular updates.

Also launching on October 14, several powerful robots and weapons will be added to the general progression system. This includes the Mesa and Ceres War Robots, along with the Nucleon and Apollo weapons. If you haven’t had a chance to try them yet, you’ll soon be able to unlock them through standard progression.

There’s a lot on the horizon, and we’re excited to bring this new content to life as War Robots: Frontiers continues to evolve.

Stay tuned—you won’t want to miss what’s coming next!

notes.title: Patch Notes — September 23, 2025
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43190071/bdf2e572e4e8c9ca532137954080b0e35e94921a.png"]

Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on September 23, 2025.
New Content & ImprovementsNew Robot & Weapon: Kumo and the Horde Shotgun
Meet Kumo, the spider-like Defender Robot, armed with its Core Gear WarpArmor. Equip Kumo with the new Horde Weapon, the Heavy Shotgun—an energy double-barrel weapon that fires a diverging blast of plasma.
Intel Discount Event 
Until September 30, special factory builds now have reduced Intel upgrade costs: Orochi, Ravana, and Fenrir, along with their gear and weapons. Don’t miss out!
Last Robot Standing Update
Game Modes Last Robot Standing+ permanently replaces the old Last Robot Standing mode in Ranked Play. The new ruleset includes the following power-ups:

Shield: Provides shield for the whole team that picks it up, regenerating 2000 per second.

Mass Regeneration: Regenerates 20000 armor of each Module for the whole team that picks it up.

Mass Armor: Increases damage resistance by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.

Mass Fuel: Increases restoration speed of fuel by 15% for the whole team that picks it up.

Mass Speed: Increases acceleration by 30% and speed by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.

Mass Ultimate: Adds a 150 points charge to Cycle Gear for the whole team that picks it up.
New Animated Skin 
The fiery Gemwrath skin is now available.
Pilot Recruitment Program 
A referral button has been added to the game. Invite your friends and fight side by side!
Gameplay AdjustmentsBalance Changes
Warp Scythe Gear Progression

Rebalanced stats across levels 1–13 for smoother progression. Damage values and cooldown adjustments ensure a more consistent power curve.

Level 01: Damage 14584 => 14601, Distance 70m => 62m, Cooldown 43s => 43s

Level 02: Damage 15352 => 16045, Distance 70m => 62m, Cooldown 43s => 43s

Level 03: Damage 15352 => 16045, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 43s => 43s

Level 04: Damage 15352 => 17440, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 36s => 43s

Level 05: Damage 16160 => 17440, Distance 74m => 68m, Cooldown 36s => 36s

Level 06: Damage 16160 => 17440, Distance 77m => 73m, Cooldown 36s => 36s

Level 07: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 73m, Cooldown 36s => 36s

Level 08: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 36s

Level 09: Damage 17010 => 18753, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 30s

Level 10: Damage 18900 => 19950, Distance 77m => 77m, Cooldown 30s => 30s

Level 11: Damage 18900 => 19950, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 30s => 30s

Level 12: Damage 21000 => 21000, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 30s => 30s

Level 13: Damage 21000 => 21000, Distance 82m => 82m, Cooldown 25s => 25s
General
Customization Unlock Robot paint and customization options in the Hangar are now locked until level 4.

Tutorial Adjustments The starting tutorial is now off by default (can still be launched manually) and Workshop tutorial flicker issues have been resolved.

Ping Wheel Expanded quick communication with new reactions for faster teamwork.

Leavers Punishment Disabled The punishment system for leaving battles is turned off for now.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where a squad could disband if the leader left while others were ready.

Cyclops ability now cancels only on the second action instead of holding the button.

Corrected the description of Bio Repair Talent (heals the most damaged module, not random).

Fixed the Applique paint icon mismatch with its preview.

Removed the outdated tutorial quest "Open the League".

Fixed bots getting stuck on spawn points in Horizon One map (Team Deathmatch mode).

Resolved gamepad input issues with certain tutorial pop-ups.

Fixed Varangian legs sometimes becoming transparent.

Fixed a bug where Apollo shots could display a fake “0” damage number.


Need help? Contact our Support team to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten. Join the official Discord server to get more of the latest news like this.

notes.title: Patch Notes — September 9, 2025
notes.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on September 9, 2025.

notes.title: Patch Notes — August 19, 2025
notes.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on August 19, 2025.
[color=lightblue]New Content[/color]
Limited-Time Event with Returning Map: Solidus Node: Depot (August 19–26)
[color=lightblue]New Charge System for Cycle Gear & Titans[/color]
An experimental system has been introduced to help make it clearer for new players what exactly contributes to Cycle Gear and Titan activation. Certain events in-game will contribute to their activation:


Offensive Events:

Most damage dealt to a War Robot Module that directly led to its destruction

Destroying a War Robot

Destroying a Titan

Assists

Shield Damage dealt

Armor Damage dealt


Tactical Events:

Damage absorbed

Survival time

Picking up a Power-Up

Healing allies*

Deactivating, capturing, and holding Beacons and Warp Probes

Contesting Beacons and Warp Probes

Some Events may indeed cause noticeable spikes in activations. We are collecting statistics and making adjustments as quickly as possible, both to Events and the balance of Weapons and Gear, to address new and older content alike.


A balanced gameplay experience is just as crucial to us as it is to you. Your constructive feedback is extremely valuable to us, so let us know what you think of the new systems and please continue sharing your thoughts via the feedback channel on Discord!


[color=lightblue]Gameplay Adjustments[/color]
Added an ‘Apply’ button when editing a War Robot’s Paint.

Players can now earn additional Impact Points for healing allies.
[color=lightblue]Technical Adjustments[/color]
Improved performance for the PS5 client.

Fixed various crashes for the PS5 client.

Improved performance in matches on all platforms.
[color=lightblue]Bug Fixes[/color]
Gear: Fixed a bug where Gamma Beam Cycle Gear was not available in the Intel Discount event.

Gear: Fixed a bug where Scorpion’s Whiplash (Core Gear) would not enter its cooldown period when using it on the Firing Range.

Jobs: Fixed a bug where rewards for ‘The Resurgence’, ‘Fortuitous Circumstance’, and ‘Let it Bloom’ would not be credited to the player after the Job requirements had been adjusted after the previous hotfix/patch.

Maps: Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the corner of the elevator on the Solidus Node: Depot map.

Maps: Fixed a bug where players could shoot through the walls on the Solidus Node: Depot map.

War Robots: Fixed a bug where invalid War Robots would be shown in the selection when editing a Drop Team.

notes.title: Patch Notes — August 12, 2025
notes.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following patch will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on August 12, 2025.
New Content
Anansi (War Robot)

Seize the high ground with Anansi, a Tactician that boasts high maneuverability thanks to its spider-like properties. Activate its Camouflage Web (Core Gear) to render allies within the area invisible to foes.

Carmen Ruiz (Legendary Pilot)

Hand the controls over to Carmen, a confident Pilot with undeniable skills. Her Ace Talent, Press The Attack, boosts rate of fire when damaging an enemy with your Gear.

MLx2 (Weapon)

Bring the boom to battle with the new MLx2 Heavy Rocket Launcher. Use it to lock onto targets and launch a hail of homing missiles.

Scrubber (Titan Weapon)

Load up your Matriarch with new weapons designed to erase the enemy. 

Suppressor (Supply Gear)

Equip your Defender War Robots with a sticky grenade that weakens nearby foes. 

Spirit Core (Animated Wrap)

Show off your fighting spirit with this dynamic style.

Technical Adjustments
US servers have been split into three separate servers:

US East

US Central

US West

Improved stability for the PS5 client.
Gameplay AdjustmentsLeaver Penalty
To reduce the number of players who leave matches prematurely, match rewards will no longer be distributed to players who leave a match before a certain point.
Chassis Upgrades
The upgrade system for all War Robot Chassis in the game, including Titans, has been reworked and rebalanced.

Previously, some Chassis only upgraded Acceleration, while others only upgraded Max Speed. Now all Chassis receive upgrades to both stats.

Most Chassis retain the same stats as before at level 5, except for those with very low Acceleration. The new minimum Acceleration in the game is now set to 30, and has been assigned to Bulwark ( previously 27). Other low-Acceleration Chassis received similar or slightly smaller increases depending on their original values.

The Armor gained per level has been significantly increased, and total Armor at max level has also been slightly raised.
Workshop
The Info Panel in the Workshop for both War Robots and Titans has been updated.

The stats now update automatically when switching between Modules.

Differences between changes are now visually highlighted.

The layout has been improved for better readability.

Factory Wraps can now be customized with customization options such as Decals, Materials, Stickers, and Weathering.

A Revert function has also been implemented for Factory Wraps, restoring the Wrap to its factory default state.

The maximum Sticker size has been increased.
Crews
Players can now request to join Crews via their Friend List.

Switching to other screens while the status of a Crew is set to ‘Ready’ may not allow the players to join the match. To prevent this, players in a Crew who set their status to ‘Ready’ will now have their UI disabled. Players can set their status back to ‘Not Ready’ by pressing the ‘Play’ button again.
Balance ChangesFuel Burn (Supply Gear)
Fuel Burn has had its mechanics slightly reworked.

After using Fuel Burn, Fuel Regeneration is now blocked for 5 seconds.

Upgrading Fuel Burn no longer increases its range. The range is now set to 375 meters across all levels.

Ability Charges have been reduced from 6 to 4.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where Ceres could not jump as high as intended.

Fixed a bug where the arrow icons to scroll through War Robot Builds in the Workshop would not display when there are 7 Builds.

Fixed a bug where, after fully unlocking a War Robot via progression tracking, the system would not automatically track the next War Robot to unlock.

Fixed a bug where the ‘Track Item Unlock’ button was displayed for Titans in the Rewards track.

Fixed a bug where players were unable to assign a newly created Robot Build to the Hangar.

Fixed a bug where the spawn animations would occasionally not play correctly.

Fixed a bug where wrong values were shown for ‘Sprint Reactor’. The values now correctly show the speed in km/h.
[hr][/hr]
Follow the game on X and Facebook and join the official Discord server to get all the latest hotfix info.

Need help? Contact our Support team to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — July 31, 2025
notes.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on July 31, 2025.
[color=lightblue]Battle Pass Adjustments[/color]
Players working through the Free Battle Pass can now earn enough Tokens to access all 4 Shipments of the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass, with some items still locked for Battle Pass Gold players.
[color=lightblue]Gameplay Adjustments[/color]
Matchmaking now prioritizes Crews of 4 or more to only be able to play with other Crews of the same size. This change is to protect solo-queue players from playing against full organised groups, and allows organised groups to match together easier.

Maximum matchmaking time for Crews consisting of 4 or more players has been changed to 5 minutes.
[color=lightblue]Bug Fixes[/color]
To correctly allow all players to unlock Shipment 4, some Shipment 3 items have been moved from Battle Pass Gold to the Free Battle Pass.

Fixed several crash related issues on PlayStation®5.

Fixed a bug where ‘Homing Missile’ would deal more damage than intended.

Fixed a bug where the system would attempt to sell the last highlighted item in the Warehouse instead of the selected item.

Fixed a bug where the Premium Account Status could not be activated while in the ‘Now Unlocking’ page.
[hr][/hr]
Follow the game on X and Facebook and join the official Discord server to get all the latest hotfix info.

[color=lightblue]New Content[/color][color=lightblue]Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass[/color]
The Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass is your way of evolving and adapting to new battles on the Wild Ten. Play to earn XP and Battle Tokens, level up your Pass, and exchange your Battle Tokens for new electrifying content.

New War Robot: Mesa (Defender) with Harmonizer (Core Gear) added.

New Weapon: Locust (Light | Kinetic | Shotgun) added.

Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on July 15, 2025.
New ContentNew War Robot and Weapon
A new unannounced War Robot and Weapon have been added to the game as part of the Store and Daily Deals. 

More details regarding this War Robot will be revealed in a separate publication on July 15, 2025!

Intel Discount Event

Titans: Alpha

Note: As the Alpha Weapon “Bayonet” is newly added to the game, it will not be included as part of this event.

More details on reductions will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.
Daily Deal Bonus Feature
We have added a loyalty feature to the Daily Deals section. When purchasing Salvage from Daily Deals, players can now receive additional rewards for hitting Milestones on total amounts of purchased Salvage. These rewards include Intel and customization options, including a new customization type: Animated Wraps.

More details on exact rewards and milestones will be shared in a separate publication on July 15, 2025.
Daily Deal Freeze Feature
We have added the option to freeze Daily Deals. This option lets you select an item in Daily Deals and prevent it from rotating out, allowing you to save an item you’re interested in until you’re ready to buy it.

You can only freeze one item at a time.

If you decide you do not want the item you have frozen, you can remove your freeze and add it to another item that you desire.

The freeze will be lifted on the reset timer of Daily Deals and if you refresh your Daily Deals manually. If you refresh your Daily Deals manually, remember to reapply your Freeze before refreshing again.

With the introduction of the Freeze Feature and Bonus Feature for Daily Deals, the “Buy All” button price (WarpReals) has been increased. The price will also increase dynamically after the second purchase. The dynamic pricing resets to the starting value each day.
Animated Wraps
A new type of customization has been added to the game: Animated Wraps. In this update, two Animated Wraps have been added to the game:

Hyperpop - Available through Daily Deal Bonus Reward milestones.

Pyroclast - Available through WarpReal bundles in the Store.

You can equip your Animated Wrap similar to Factory Wraps. Select the War Robot you would like to Paint and then equip your newly found Animated Wrap from the Wraps interface.

The minimap now shows the exact location of Power Ups, even if they are still on cooldown.

Defender:

notes.title: Season 2: Power Surge | Patch Notes — June 17, 2025
notes.content:
Incoming, Pilots! A new major update will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on June 17, 2025. This update will introduce Season 2: Power Surge, and a host of new content and quality-of-life updates.
New ContentSeason 2: Power Surge
The battle for Terminus continues. Despite the ongoing blockade, Pilots have adapted and found new sources of supplies. Some have learned to scavenge and build, while others have turned to smuggling. But just as life on Tortuga seems to be getting back on track, the Warp network collapses, paralyzing all activities in the Wild Ten. With everything at stake, it’s up to the Pilots to fix what's broken.
War Robots: Loki & Mesa
Loki (Unlockable via the Scavenger’s Hunt Battle Pass & Daily Deals): Trickster by name, trickster by nature. Loki's ability to use holographic projections makes it an excellent infiltrator and scout. Its armor is strong for its class, and its anti-shield firepower means it can easily take on flankers, though it should avoid encounters with heavier foes. Add Loki to your Drop Team and see what this stealthy War Robot can do. 

Mesa (Unlockable via the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass & Daily Deals from July 29): Defend ‘til the end with Mesa, a strong defender with amazing ally-protecting abilities. Deploy barriers to shield Mesa and its teammates from projectiles, or unleash a biotech drone that follows alongside it, buffing allies and weakening enemies in the area. 
Titan: Volta
Volta (Unlockable via account progression at Level 50): Turn up the voltage. This live wire Titan is the first quadruped to be built on Tortuga, and it’s as aggressive as it is electrifying. With its ability to double jump and hover, these new traversal capabilities are sure to set Volta apart from other Titans on the battlefield. Activate its electric weapon, generate a moving barrier, or block projectiles and deal damage to enemies foolish enough to pass through.
Game Mode: Spearhead
Powerslide into a brand-new game mode: Spearhead. 

Two teams fight over randomly spawning Warp Probes to stabilize Warp in the region. Locate and capture them first to earn Points! Hit the Points cap, stay ahead, or eliminate all enemies to win.
Battle Pass: Scavenger’s Haul
Whether you’re on the Free track or want to upgrade your Battle Pass to earn more rewards, dozens of adrenaline-pumping rewards are waiting to be unlocked:

Loki Modules

Halo Weapons

Recon Mode (Cycle Gear)

Fuel Burn (Supply Gear)

5 Stickers

5 Paints

2 Decals

2 Wear and Tears

1 Common Pilot

Intel, Credits & Salvage

In Season 1: Blockade, new Shipments for the Battle Pass were added regularly, unlocking access to new pages of rewards as they arrived. Starting with Season 2: Power Surge, all Battle Pass rewards will be available to unlock from day one. Earn those Battle Tokens to be among the first Pilots to construct Loki!

Additionally, Intel can now be obtained from the Battle Pass for free. You can earn up to 200 Intel through free progression, a crucial resource used to upgrade your best Builds.

We’ve also rebalanced the Battle Pass and Free progression to give you even more Credits, Salvage, and Intel throughout the Pass. You can still complete at least one full Shipment (plus change) without upgrading your Pass, but Free progression will not award enough Battle Tokens to obtain the Torso or Chassis Modules on Shipment 2 and beyond. However, keep an eye on Daily Deals, and you can spend your Credits on the Modules and Weapons you seek!

A new Battle Pass will launch on July 29: Spark of Ingenuity. Be sure to collect all your rewards in Scavenger’s Haul before this date!
Battle Pass Content Available in Daily Deals
War Robots and Weapons will now launch in Daily Deals at the same time they’re available in the Battle Pass! This change is designed to give Pilots more options for unlocking battle gear, without having to spend WarpReals.

With the launch of Season 2: Power Surge, Loki Modules and the Halo Weapon are now available in Daily Deals, along with Scorpion Modules and the Tusk Weapon from Season 1: Blockade.
Hero Pilot: Sora Sing
Unleash the sparky Sora Sing (available in the Store) as your War Robot’s new Pilot. This infamous femme fatale has found herself with a public persona she may not deserve, taking the fall for war crimes which saw her stripped of her citizenship, and expatriated to the Wild Ten—the only place that would take her. 

While her fellow Pilots may not trust her just yet, her talents hit all the high notes, and her ability to reload faster and boost damage (among others) make her a more than capable Pilot. Remember, it’s not over until the Sora sings…
Map Updates: Spectrum & Fissure

Weekly Jobs

Balancing AdjustmentsGeneral

Destroying a Titan in Team Deathmatch (TDM) now yields 10% less Titan Charge Points. Destroying a Robot now yields 11% more Titan Charge Points.

Mines that are deployed are invisible to enemy players.

A mine detonates when an enemy War Robot steps on it, dealing damage over an area and slowing the enemy down. The slowing effect does not increase on repeated mine detonations.

The mine spread has been reduced. War Robots can no longer pass through the minefield without triggering an explosion.

Increased Chassis Pelvis Armor from 121,000 to 172,000.

Increased Shoulder Armor from 200,000 to 215,000.

Reduced the repairing potency of Nanite Field from 5% Armor per second to 4.7% Armor per second.
Mesa (War Robot)
Increased Torso Armor from 110,000 to 116,000.

Increased Chassis Leg Armor from 100,000 to 116,000.

Increased Chassis Pelvis Armor from 100,000 to 116,000.

Increased Shoulder Armor from 112,000 to 140,000.
Purifier (War Robot)
Increased Torso Armor from 116,600 to 160,000.

Increased Chassis Leg Armor from 103,400 to 147,400.

Increased Chassis Pelvis Armor from 103,400 to 147,400.

Increased Shoulder Armor from 122,100 to 160,000.
Ravana (War Robot)
Increased Torso Armor from 121,000 to 165,000.

Increased Chassis Leg Armor from 110,000 to 154,000.

Increased Chassis Pelvis Armor from 110,000 to 154,000.

Increased Shoulder Armor from 133,100 to 150,400.
Scorpion (War Robot)
Increased the lingering damage duration of Whiplash from 5 seconds to 7 seconds.
Typhon
Reworked the projectile trajectory of Blackout (Core Gear). Projectiles should now hit targets more reliably.
Volta (Titan)
Galvanic Screen has been moved to the Torso Module. Tesla Coil has been moved to the Shoulder Module.

Increased the damage of Tesla Coil from 10,000 to 13,500.
Pilot TalentsDeflector Gizmo
Incoming damage is no longer absorbed, only reflected.

Increased the rate of reflected damage from 15% to 30%.

Increased the Talent cooldown from 7 seconds to 10 seconds.
Ricochet
The chance of Ricochet taking effect has been reduced from 10% to 5%.
General AdjustmentsMatchmaking
Previously, players were matched based on their win rate. With this update, we will base it first on League Points, then on win rate to ensure more evenly balanced matchmaking.

We have added an unranked matchmaking group for players at Level 7–14. Players will be matched with Bronze League starting at Level 15.
Leagues
League placements will be reset, and ranks will be adjusted for Season 2:

Players ranked in Silver will start in Bronze.

Players ranked in Gold will start in Silver.

Players ranked in Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, or Noachium will start in Gold.

League Points will be set according to your new League placement:

Bronze = 0 League Points

Silver = 300 League Points

Gold = 600 League Points

Additionally, the amount of League Points needed to reach Noachium has been increased to 4,000 League Points.
Store
The Store now includes a section to display the chances for items to appear in Daily Deals.

Added a dynamic cost to refreshing Daily Deals, along with the first refresh being in Credits. The refreshing cost resets daily.

First Refresh: 700 Credits

Second Refresh: 15 WarpReals

Third Refresh: 25 WarpReals

Fourth Refresh: 35 WarpReals

Fifth Refresh and above: 45 WarpReals

Players will now be redirected to the Store when attempting to purchase an item with insufficient currency.
Hangar, Workshop & Warehouse
Filtering/sorting options will now persist after crafting or upgrading an item.

Newly acquired items will now include a “NEW” icon.

Added a hint message under the War Robot that provides information about why it can’t be assembled.

Added a “Disassemble” button to Factory Builds.

Added a “Go Back to Editing” button that appears when removing a War Robot from the Hangar. This allows players to continue working on a Build instead of being forced to revert or save the changes.

Added acquisition details for Modules.

Added an “Install to Hangar” button when editing a Robot Build.

Improved the camera behavior in the Workshop and Warehouse.

Navigation lines pointing to modules when building a War Robot have been improved in the workshop.

War Robot and Titan icons in the Factory have been updated.
Player Progression
Expanded the player account progression. The maximum player level has been increased to 95.

Item rewards through the level progression now display item descriptions.
General
Swapping or adding War Robots in the Hangar tab now displays a quick-select menu highlighting completed builds called "Battle-Ready Robots”.

Crew Codes have been shortened for better ease of use. Crew codes now only include digits and Latin characters.

Players will be shown visual feedback when accepting a Squad Invitation.

Added showcase videos to Weapons and Gear in the Warehouse, Store, Battle Pass, and Level Progression screens.

Module Switch Tabs/Hotkeys have been added to the Customize Robot User Interface.

Pilot Talents are now displayed in a tabular format within the Talent window.

Added in-world descriptions to cosmetic items.

Added acquisition details to Currencies.

Added explanations about Cycle Gear & Supply Gear in the Gear Info Panel.

Added shortcuts for items that have been obtained to make it easier for players to efficiently use them immediately.

Added a shortcut that allows players to immediately add a new Factory Build or Titan to their Hangar if they received one.

Added a shortcut that allows players to immediately open the Warehouse if they have received a new Pilot.

Added a shortcut that allows players to immediately craft a newly received Blueprint.

Added a shortcut that allows players to immediately open the Battle Pass if they received a Battle Pass Token.

All Common Pilots now look unique from one another, featuring different coloured suits and helmets.

Added new Combat Reactions for Common Pilots.

Reworked the “Battle Help” screen (pressing F1 during a match).

Server Maintenance notifications will now be displayed in the main menu ahead of upcoming downtime.

The Smart Ping Wheel has been improved for better ease of use.

The keybinding for the Smart Ping Wheel can be reassigned.

Bots will now replace players when they leave a match.

A player can rejoin the match within a certain amount of time and continue fighting.

If the player is gone for too long, they will be replaced by a bot until the end of the match.

Match rewards are counted accordingly.

Players that have not yet connected to a match are greyed out in the pre-match screen.

Added a voice chat activation prompt.

Added a notification that confirms a purchase and lists the items that have been purchased.

Adjusted some sound effects for weapon reloading and various user interfaces.
Technical ImprovementsGeneral
Improved haptic feedback and gamepad vibrations in combat.

Improved and reworked points across all maps where Robots could get stuck.

Players are now able to link their Facebook account without linking an email address.
Sound
Improved the overall sound balance in the game.

All sound effects, from the sounds of mechanics to gunfire and movement, have become cleaner, clearer, and more realistic for better immersion.

Resolved various bugs where sounds could overlap or stick under certain circumstances.

Reworked the SFX of Purifier’s Zealot (Core Gear).

Added new sound effects informing players that a Titan is ready to spawn.
Visual
Improved visuals of the Catalyst map.

Improved lighting in the Hangar.

Improved Weapon and Gear VFX.
Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where certain weapons and abilities did not show hit markers when hitting a target.

Fixed a bug where installing an owned Module in a Robot Build did not update the holographic preview. It would remain red and only update after exiting editing.

Fixed a bug where upgrading Grim’s weapon “Katzbalger” would be more expensive than other Titan weapons.

Fixed a bug where the charging animation of the weapon “Fowler” would continue after the weapon was fully charged.

Fixed a bug where an empty notification box would be displayed when saving a Robot build.

Fixed a bug where the projectiles of the weapon “Gemini” would occasionally explode right after firing.

Fixed a bug where Jetpack fire VFX would continuously come out of the War Robot’s exhaust vents.

Fixed a bug where Infinite Ammo (Supply Gear) would occasionally last indefinitely.

Fixed a bug where the League icon was not centered on the Teams screen.

Fixed a bug where Griffin's Electronic Warfare (Core Gear) could be scanned by Orochi’s Echo Burst (Core Gear).

Fixed a bug where the “Place” button was not visible when trying to select a Decal that was not installed.

Fixed a bug where opening the Social menu while editing a Robot Build would revert all changes made to the Build.

Fixed a bug where the animations of the Robots’ legs would break when jumping on the lift on the Fissure map.

Fixed a bug where players could teleport inside tunnels with Grim’s Scythe.

Fixed a bug that caused the incorrect audio to play when claiming inbox rewards containing a Pilot.

Fixed a bug where no error message was displayed when trying to convert a Factory Build to a Custom Build when the Custom Build Limit has been reached.

Fixed a bug where the 3D model of the selected Gear would not be displayed when upgrading it.

Fixed a bug where the War Robot’s Power Up phrase would not be played when standing on top of the power-up before it respawned.

Fixed a bug where players could obtain more rewards from Jobs than intended

Fixed various bugs where sounds could overlap or stick under certain circumstances.

Fixed a bug where some robot parts at low graphical settings would have problems displaying in certain circumstances.

Fixed a bug with where the weapon Gozer would remain invisible after using invisibility.

MERCENARY CONTRACTS REPORTED ON THE WILD TEN
By Duke Blanko, Reporter (Mars News Network)

New reports from the Wild Ten today revealed that mercenary contracts have been issued to War Robot Pilots by the Freecon, Mayflower, and FortEvo Dominions. Military strategists and politicians have been meeting in secret to discuss the impact this will have on much-needed trade and mining facilities across the Wild Ten, once considered a safe haven for trade. 

War Robots are said to be the ultimate war machines, equipped with top-of-the-line weapons and gear, and are only surpassed by a new technology—Titans. Even bigger and more dangerous, a Titan can wipe out a whole team of War Robots, leading to even more battles, and even more contracts for eager Pilots to take on. 

As the residents, mechanics, leaders, and Pilots begin their journey down the road of war, only time will tell if these upcoming battles will result in anything other than mass destruction.

By Duke Blanko, Reporter (Mars News Network)

Chaos erupted today at Terminus, the gateway to the Wild Ten system. Pilots and residents alike could be seen panicking as supply lines were blocked, leaving the black market open for a comeback. One resourceful Pilot who refused to give his name (despite appearing to be followed by a lie detector drone) described the recent events as “an opportunity to make some quick cash with some bits I found… lying around.” 

Mechanics are especially concerned with the supply port cut off, but have vowed to rebuild War Robots for Pilots taking on contracts. One such mechanic named “The Lace” told us, “The black market may be sketchy, but these Pilots need Modules, and we will provide them one way or another.” 

While some Pilots fear an escalating conflict, for most, it's just another day in the Wild Ten.

You may know me as the voice of Radio Tortuga, but you probably didn’t know I’m also an intergalactic fashionista! Your War Robot may be shabby (and put together with stolen parts), but that doesn’t mean it can’t be stylish. 

Take your bot from drab to fab with Decals, Stickers, and Paint. Stand out from the crowd with the hottest Robot around.

notes.title: Upcoming Changes to the Battle Pass, Progression & Daily Deals
notes.content:
Season 2: Power Surge is set to bring a cargo load of new improvements and changes to War Robots: Frontiers. Alongside a fresh delivery of seasonal content and rewards, we’ve also been working on important changes to the Battle Pass, account progression, and what’s available in Daily Deals to expand construction and customization possibilities for all players. 

Read on to learn more, including details about upcoming events in War Robots: Frontiers!
Battle Pass: Shipment Unlock Timer Removed
In Season 1: Blockade, new Shipments for the Battle Pass were added on a regular basis, unlocking access to new pages of rewards throughout the duration of the Battle Pass. Starting with Season 2: Power Surge and the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass on June 17, all Battle Pass rewards will be available to unlock from day one. Earn those Battle Tokens to be among the first Pilots to construct Loki!
Battle Pass Rewards: Intel Added to Free Progression
Intel can now be obtained from the Battle Pass for free. Starting with the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass (launching June 17), you’ll be able to earn up to 200 Intel through free progression, a crucial resource used to upgrade your best Builds.
[previewyoutube=fO_xcoY9QZs;full][/previewyoutube]
Battle Pass Content Coming to Daily Deals on Day One
War Robots and Weapons will launch in Daily Deals at the same time they’re available in the Battle Pass! This change is designed to give Pilots more options for unlocking battle gear, without having to spend WarpReals.

Season 2: Power Surge will introduce Loki Modules and the Halo Weapon to Daily Deals at the beginning of the Season, with Scorpion Modules and the Tusk Weapon from Season 1: Blockade also joining the Daily Deals roster.

We’ve also rebalanced the Battle Pass and Free progression to give you even more Credits, Salvage, and Intel throughout the Pass. You can still complete at least one full Shipment (plus change) without upgrading your Pass, but Free progression will not award enough Battle Tokens to obtain the Torso or Chassis Modules on Shipment 2 and beyond. However, keep an eye on Daily Deals, and you can spend your Credits on the Modules and Weapons you seek!
Daily Deals Refresh Changes
If you’re hunting for that perfect Module or Weapon, your first Daily Refresh will now cost 700 Credits instead of WarpReals. This is designed to increase your chances of getting the Daily Deal you want, without spending WarpReals. You should be able to earn this amount of Credits from a single Daily Job, so happy hunting and shopping, Pilots!

Further Daily Refreshes beyond your first will still cost WarpReals, with more Refreshes available at rising increments (starting at 15 WarpReals for your first, and increasing by 10 each time up to a maximum of 45 WarpReals). 
[previewyoutube=rbw2_88PPlo;full][/previewyoutube]
Daily Deals Chances
You can check a new chance table on Daily Deals to view your percentage chance of seeing certain items based on their rarity. This is designed to increase transparency on the rewards available and set expectations on what you might find there.
[previewyoutube=D0wIpvjvvkw;full][/previewyoutube]
Account Progression: New Account Levels & Rewards
More Account Levels and rewards have been added! Players can now progress to Level 95 (up from Level 80). The new progression rewards include a Cyclops War Robot (Factory Build), with new Modules available at every third Level (Levels 83, 86, 89, 92, 95). 30 Intel will be awarded at every other Level (e.g. Levels 81, 82, 84, etc.)

Even more Account Levels and progression rewards (including Scorpion Modules) will be added alongside the Spark of Ingenuity Battle Pass, launching July 29.
[previewyoutube=EFzvWm3j_hY;full][/previewyoutube]
Season 2: Upcoming Events
Plug into Season 2: Power Surge when it launches on June 17 to enjoy celebratory events:
Twitch Drops: Tune in to War Robots: Frontiers Content Creators on Twitch to earn rewards!Intel Catch-up: A special event for returning and new players to help get your Builds up to scratch.Pilot XP Event: Put your Pilots through a rigorous boot camp to bring out their best in battle.New Credit Offers: Idy Demerost (Hero Pilot) and Fury (War Robot) with Pulsar Weapons will be available to buy for Credits, replacing Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot) and Griffin (War Robot).New Titan Weapon Coming to Daily Deals: Jigsaw, a new Titan Weapon built for Grim, will be available via Daily Deals for a limited time (stay tuned for more details).
Keep your eyes on your comms, Pilots!

notes.title: Playtest: Try Season 2 Content From May 15-16!
notes.content:
Ready to put the battlefield to the test, Pilot? Participate in the upcoming Playtest from May 15–16 and help shape the future of War Robots: Frontiers.

[remindme][/remindme]

This Playtest will let you test out the new content arriving in Season 2: Power Surge.We look forward to hearing your feedback!

IMPORTANT: This Playtest is only available on Steam. This allows us to test the stability of new builds with a clean slate before deploying to all platforms.
Playtest Dates & TimesStart – Thursday, May 15, 14:00 CEST/05:00 PTEnd – Friday, May 16, 16:00 CEST/07:00 PTNew Content
Test out upcoming Season 2: Power Surge content, including:
Titan (Volta): Turn up the voltage with a brand-new quadruped Titan.New Game Mode (Spearhead): Capture Warp Probes to seize victory.War Robots (Loki and Mesa): Use stealth and strength in equal measure.Weapons (Halo and Locust): Deal major damage with these new shotguns.Supply Gear (Ammo Fabricator): Deploy a device that boosts the reload speed of allies in range.Hero Pilot (Sora Sing): Unleash the sparky Sora Sing as your War Robot’s new Pilot.
Balancing Adjustments
Weapons
Artillery Weapons (Noricum, Rampant, Magneto)
Reworked the mechanics of artillery weapon explosions:Explosions no longer penetrate barriers, domes, walls, and other terrain elements.
Gemini
Changed the flight path of the projectiles. The missiles now stabilize faster.Added splash damage to the projectiles. Missiles now deal 1,660 splash damage to Armor within a radius of 3.5m.Increased damage to Armor from 7,500 to 8,160.
Dragoon

notes.title: Season 2: Power Surge – Electrifying New Update Lands June 17!
notes.content:
Prepare for the Power Surge when Season 2 launches on June 17! Soup up new War Robots Loki and Mesa, charge into battle in the new Spearhead game mode, boost your arsenal with the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass, take control of the new Titan Volta, and much more.

[previewyoutube=nJqvs_fl1kM;full][/previewyoutube]

The battle for Terminus continues. Despite the ongoing blockade, Pilots have adapted and found new sources of supplies. Some have learned to scavenge and build, while others turned to smuggling. But just as life on Tortuga seems to be getting back on track, the Warp network collapses, paralyzing all activities in the Wild Ten. With everything at stake, it’s up to the Pilots to fix what's broken. 
Power Up With A New Playtest
Eager to try out the new content below before the launch of Season 2? Join our upcoming playtest from May 15–16 (Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher only). Keep your eyes peeled for more information coming soon!
Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass
Boost your Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass (arriving June 17) to unlock dozens of adrenaline-pumping rewards, including exclusive cosmetics, battle gear, and a new War Robot: Loki!

That’s not all. On July 29, unlock the Spark Of Ingenuity Battle Pass, containing even more incredible rewards, including another new War Robot: Mesa! 
New Titan: Volta 
Turn up the voltage with a brand new Titan: Volta. This live wire Titan is the first quadruped to be built on Tortuga, and it’s as aggressive as it is electrifying. With its ability to double jump and hover, these new traversal capabilities are sure to set Volta apart from other Titans on the battlefield. 

Activate its electric weapon, generate a moving barrier, or block projectiles and deal damage to enemies foolish enough to pass through.

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/1.png
Map Updates: Spectrum & Fissure
Much has happened in the Wild Ten since the beginning of the blockade. Freecon rebuilt the Spectrum Research Facility, seemingly preparing for the next stage of their mysterious experiment, and the Fissure mining site was taken over by Warp anomalies. Despite that, mining operations here are still ongoing. 

Have any of these events caused the Warp blackout? At this point, we can only speculate.

What we know for sure is that both the Spectrum and Fissure maps received a massive facelift, along with better weather setups and improved terrain readability.
New Game Mode: Spearhead
Powerslide into a brand-new game mode: Spearhead. 

Two teams fight over randomly spawning Warp Probes to stabilize Warp in the region. Locate and capture them first to earn Points! Hit the Points cap, stay ahead, or eliminate all enemies to win. 

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/2.png
New War Robots: Loki & Mesa Loki
Trickster by name, trickster by nature. Loki's ability to use holographic projections makes it an excellent infiltrator and scout. Its armor is strong for its class, and its anti-shield firepower means it can easily take on flankers, though it should avoid encounters with heavier foes. Add Loki to your Drop Team and see what this stealthy War Robot can do. 

Unlock Loki through the Scavenger’s Haul Battle Pass (coming June 17).

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/05/210-PowerSurgeAnnounce/3.png
Mesa
Defend ‘til the end with Mesa, a strong defender with amazing ally-protecting abilities. Deploy barriers to shield Mesa and its teammates from projectiles, or unleash a biotech drone that follows alongside it, buffing allies and weakening enemies in the area. 

Make Mesa your mate later in Season 2 through the Spark Of Ingenuity Battle Pass (coming July 22). 
New Hero Pilot: Sora Sing
Unleash the sparky Sora Sing as your War Robot’s new Pilot. This infamous femme fatale has found herself with a public persona she may not deserve, taking the fall for war crimes which saw her stripped of her citizenship, and expatriated to the Wild Ten—the only place that would take her. 

While her fellow Pilots may not trust her just yet, her talents hit all the high notes, and her ability to reload faster and boost damage (among others) make her a more than capable Pilot. Remember, it’s not over until the Sora Sings…

Sora Sing will be available in the Store.
Updated Leagues Rewards System
In a recent Dev Diary, we announced that rewards from previous League ranks would also be earnable. For example, if you reach Gold in Milestone 1, you will receive Bronze, Silver, and Gold rewards. However, if you reach Diamond in Milestone 2, you will receive only the Milestone 2 rewards for Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, and Diamond.

We are not changing the way that Milestone rewards work in Season 2, meaning that if a player joins during Milestone 2, they cannot obtain the Milestone 1 rewards 

The total number of leagues and requirement points will stay the same, but players will drop Leagues at the beginning of Season 2. For example, if you land in Silver at the end of Season 1, you will begin in Bronze in Season 2.

For more information on recently implemented changes and exciting upcoming events, keep an eye out for a new Q&A video, info on an upcoming Playtest, and a Leagues Event.

notes.title: War Robot Spotlight: Scorpion
notes.content:
As a Wild Ten Pilot, it’s good to get to grips with your partner in battle—the War Robot. With 18 War Robots to choose from, each with their own unique attributes, picking the best ally for each fight is crucial.

Take to the battlefield in Scorpion, a War Robot that deals devastating damage behind enemy lines.

[previewyoutube=Iv4KtLaEYeg;full][/previewyoutube]
COMBAT ANALYSISWar Robot Model: ScorpionClass: FlankerDominion: FortEvo
Calculating and creeping, Scorpion has the ability to sneak up on foes and dispatch them like a true assassin.

With a real sting in its tail, this War Robot was created to pick off stragglers with its Whiplash Core Gear. In the right hands, it can take down a whole squad of enemies, one after the other.

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/04/207-Scorpion/1.png
UNDER THE HOOD
Make the most of your War Robot by learning about its Core Gear and recommended Weapons, Supply Gear, and Cycle Gear.

Don’t forget—you can always customize any War Robot with your favorite elements! 
Whiplash (Core Gear): A homing projectile that deals damage on a hit, then additional damage per second to all Modules It also recharges if a target is destroyed while active.Tusk (Light Weapon - Kinetic): Charge up this ballistic shotgun to gore enemies at longer range and with reduced spread.Gamma Beam (Cycle Gear): Locks onto an enemy, dealing damage per second that increases based on proximity.Repulsor (Supply Gear): Deals damage to enemies and pushes them and you away from each other.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — April 29, 2025
notes.content:
Watch those shields, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on April 29, 2025.

The majority of these changes were tested by the War Robots: Frontiers community in our recent Balancing Playtest. Thank you to all the Pilots who participated and helped us finetune these improvements and rebalancing updates! For more detailed information about the reasoning and feedback that led to these changes, check out the Balancing Playtest article.
Gameplay AdjustmentsBattle
We received very positive feedback regarding the adjustments to Spawn Points and the Respawn buff, and will be implementing them in this update:
Spawn Points no longer provide a damage buff, only damage resistance.Last Robot Standing: Changed Spawn Points and removed the timer from them.StoreImproved the visibility of the end timer for the Battle Pass.“Customization” is now displayed as the seventh category in the Store.The Store will no longer automatically cycle through categories if a player manually switches between offers.Balance AdjustmentsWeaponsIncinerator: We are applying our changes from the recent Balancing Playtest. Reworked its damage over time (DoT) effect – it now stacks when using multiple Weapons of this type, and scales with the Weapon’s base damage, improving as the Weapon is upgraded.Armor DoT: 7,000 per second by each Weapon at max Lvl (previously 18,000)Shield DoT: 1,000 (previously 3,000)Lighter: We are applying our changes from the recent Balancing Playtest. Redistributed area of effect (AoE) and direct damage.Direct Damage To Shields: 465 (previously 420)Direct Damage To Armor: 515 (previously 445)AoE Damage To Shields: 90 (previously 135)AoE Damage To Armor: 200 (previously 270)AoE Radius: Reduced by 28.6%Vortex: We are applying the change from the recent Balancing Playtest. Projectiles now travel directly to the target (no longer predictive).Tusk: These changes were not tested in our most recent Balancing Playtest, however, they have been carefully planned, and we are confident in their necessity based on the initial feedback regarding Tusk.Rebalanced various values:Initial Projectile Speed: 12,000 (previously 38,000)Initial Spread X: 3 (previously 5)Initial Spread Y: 5 (previously 8)Armor Damage: 8,400 (previously 6,100)Shield Damage: 4,400 (previously 3,800)Charge Time: 0.9 sec (previously 1.2 sec)Reload Time: 4 sec (previously 3 sec)
Dev Note: Changes for Noricum didn’t make it into the most recent Balancing Playtest, but will be included in the next one. We’re aware of some frustration around this Weapon and are preparing adjustments. Thank you for your patience!
GearCore Gear: Cold Snap (Siren): Removed the area of effect (AoE), adjusted the cooldown for various upgrade levels, and reduced the freeze duration.Adjusted Cooldowns:Level 1: 66 sec (previously 40 sec)Level 5: 57 sec (previously 33 sec)Level 9: 51 sec (previously 28 sec)Level 13: 45 sec (previously 25 sec)Freeze Duration: 5 seconds (previously 6 seconds)
Dev Note: The changes were well received during the Balancing Playtest, but many players pointed out that the proposed changes for lower upgrade levels caused Cold Snap’s cooldown to be too long. We have reduced the cooldown for lower levels based on the Playtest, but they are still higher than previously on live.
Pilot TalentsBio Repair: Armor Restoration changed to 4,000 per sec (previously 2,000 per sec).Bullet-Catcher: Armor Bonus changed to 8% (previously 6%).Deflector Gizmo: Damage Reflected changed to 15% (previously 30%). Decreased the Damage Return value to 15% (previously 30%). Added a 7-second cooldown between each activation.Dev Note: We’re preparing more mechanical changes for Deflector Gizmo, but they require additional testing and will appear in future patches.Field Repairs: Armor Restoration changed to 4,000 (previously 2,000).Fuel Thief: Instantly replenishes 5 Fuel when triggered.Gear Resonator: Damage Resistance changed to 7% (previously 4%).Maximizer: Damage changed to 100,000 (previously 200,000).Press the Attack: Fire rate boost is 15% for 7 seconds (previously 30%)Prizefighter: Armor Restoration changed to 7,500 Armor (previously 10,000 Armor). Decreased activation range to 150m (previously 200m).Dev Note: In addition to being highly effective, Prizefighter also turned out to be too versatile, leading us to decrease its activation range.Quick Reflexes: Duration changed to 15 sec (previously 5 sec).Scavenger: Ammo Restoration changed to 30% (previously 20%).Siege Tower: Time to stand still changed to 3s (previously 5 sec).Trigger-Happy: Rate of Fire changed to 4% (previously 6%).Well-Timed: Time to stand still changed to 3s (previously 5s).Bug FixesGeneralFixed a bug where the camera would spawn below the map when a match starts.Fixed a bug with the Polish localization where acquisition information would overflow on the item card in the Warehouse.MapsSpectrum: Fixed a bug where the lighting was too bright.Pilot TalentsParasite Protocol: Fixed an incorrect description. This Pilot Talent does not affect Gear cooldowns.War RobotsTyphon: Fixed a bug where the icons for Typhon Modules showed incorrect colors.WeaponsVortex: Fixed a bug where the weapon displayed a white box as its icon.
We’re not stopping here — another Playtest is coming soon, where we’ll showcase even more new balance improvements. Follow the game on X and Facebook, and join the official Discord server to get all the latest hotfix intel.

Need help? Contact our Support team to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten.

notes.title: Hero Pilot Spotlight: Duncan Prasad
notes.content:
Pilots are the final puzzle piece in your loadout, and choosing the ideal companion for your War Robot is critical to your success…or failure. 

Meet Duncan Prasad, a skilled and stealthy Pilot, able to pull off risky plays with ease. However, there is more to Duncan than meets the eye. He is an enigma wrapped in a mystery, holding a stolen Pilot ID…

[previewyoutube=RROF87VwT90;full][/previewyoutube]
BACKGROUND ANALYSISName: Duncan PrasadClass: FlankerDominion: Tortuga
The Pilot known as Duncan Prasad arrived on Tortuga at a loose end. His upbringing and background are relatively unknown, but his reputation as a career criminal precedes him. Duncan thrives on thievery and the thrill of executing a flawless heist. His skills are deemed immoral, but they are just the talents that are valuable assets to mercenary crews vying for lucrative Battle Contracts. 

To survive on this new frontier, this thief must use his charm and cunning to come up with a new way to live and work. The solution? Steal another Pilot’s identity, War Robots and all. This risky gambit is paying off…for now. 

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/04/202-DuncanSpotlight/1.jpg
TACTICAL TALENTS
Every Pilot has Talents, but it’s up to you to pick the best ones for battle. Pick one Talent per Rank, and let Duncan show you what he’s made of.
Rank 1: General TalentsGearhead: Gear goes off cooldown faster.Case-Hardened: You take less damage from all sources.Feed Hacker: Your weapons reload quicker.Rank 2: Flanker Talents (Class Specific)Rocketeer: Shotguns and special weapons deal more damage.Shields Expert: Boosts shield.Fast Reflexes: Boosts primary and secondary stats of Movement Gear.Rank 3: Sneaky Talents (Personality Specific)Fuel Thief: Hitting an enemy that has not damaged you recently restores fuel.Gear Resonator: Using any Gear reduces incoming damage by a small amount for a brief period.Parasite Protocol: Every elimination increases a random parameter of your Core Gear.Rank 4: Tortuga Talents (Dominion Specific)Damage Cascade: If any enemy War Robot has more than six Modules, you deal extra weapon damage for every Module past the sixth. Closing The Deal: If your team has more eliminations than the enemy, your weapons reload faster.Titan Summoner: Every assist or elimination grants you extra Titan Points.Rank 5: Ace Talent 
Duncan acquired this Talent through hard work and dedication.
Trickster’s Triumph: Pushing an enemy’s Module into a critical stat regenerates shield.

notes.title: Balancing Playtest: Test Out Weapons From April 17–18
notes.content:
Ready to put the battlefield to the test, Pilot? Play our Balancing Playtest from April 17–18 and help shape the future of War Robots: Frontiers.

This Playtest will introduce new balancing changes for  Pilot Talents, Weapons and adjustments to the Respawn Buff. We look forward to hearing your feedback about these features!

IMPORTANT: This Playtest is only available on PC (Steam and MY.GAMES Launcher). This allows us to test the stability of new builds with a clean slate before deploying to all platforms.
Balancing Playtest Dates & TimesApril 17: 18:00 UTC - 21:00 UTC April 18: 18:00 UTC - 21:00 UTC 
[remindme][/remindme]
Balancing Adjustments
During the Playtest you will be provided with ready-made War Robots equipped in your Hangar for playtesting. Individual War Robots and levelled-up Pilots will also be available to quickly assemble builds you are familiar with. 

We are interested in feedback from players who play as or against these War Robot playstyles, so please let us know your thoughts on Discord!

These changes are in testing and may not be implemented in the live game. 
WeaponsIncinerator
We received feedback from players that Incinerator felt overly powerful in battle. After reviewing the data, we agree with these concerns. Previously, the damage-over-time effect would not stack, so regardless of the number of weapons applied to the War Robot, the damage did not scale. 

Our goal is to make this weapon feel more strategic and balanced when incorporated within builds. To achieve this, we are making adjustments to how the stacking mechanic functions for this weapon:

Updated Mechanic: 
Damage-over-time now scales based on the number of Incinerators equipped. The effect from a single flamethrower will be lower than before.When multiple flamethrowers fire simultaneously, the damage-over-time effect remains high.
Damage Adjustments:
Reduced damage to Armor per second from 18,000 (overall) to 7,000 (per weapon at max level). Reduced damage to Shields from 3,000 to 1,000.Lighter
Based on data, we felt that the spread of the area-of-effect was too large, requiring less focus to target specific Armor zones. We would like players to focus more on hitting their target directly rather than relying on splash damage, therefore we will be making the following adjustments:
Redistributed damage output by reducing area-of-effect damage and increasing direct hit damage for both Armor and Shields.Reduced the area-of-effect radius by 28.6%.Vortex
We received varying feedback that it could be difficult to hit fast-moving targets but also could be difficult for fast-moving targets to quickly evade in certain circumstances. Due to this, we will be making the following adjustments:
Projectiles no longer predict the future position of the enemy, instead, giving the target a chance to dodge. Projectiles will now travel directly to the enemy targeted (not a specific location).Noricum
We are making the following adjustment to Noricum:
Increased time between shots from 0.2 to 0.25 seconds.
While increasing the time between shots is a step towards addressing excessive spam in lower matches, we understand that this adjustment alone is not sufficient. We are actively working on more substantial changes to balance this weapon, but these adjustments are still under development and require further testing internally.

As such, they could not be included in this current playtest. We remain committed to refining Noricum to make it inline with players expectations and we will be sharing updates on these changes in the coming weeks.
GearCore Gear: Cold Snap (Siren)
Players have expressed that countering Cold Snap during combat can be particularly challenging. To address this, we aim to refine its functionality by allowing its use in combination with other gear, while increasing the precision required for effective aiming. In light of this feedback, we are introducing the following adjustments:
Removed the area-of-effect, making it no longer possible to hit multiple targets.Increased the cooldown from 25 to 45 seconds.Reduced the Freezing time from 6 to 5 seconds.Pilot Talents
We have been closely monitoring feedback regarding certain Pilot Talents and analyzing their usage across the board. Some Talents have sparked more discussion than others, leading to interesting insights from players regarding how pilots are utilized in battle. 

Based on our findings, we are going to make the following adjustments to associated Pilots:

Gear Resonator
Using any Gear reduces incoming damage by 7% (previously 4%).
Available via the following Pilots: Alex Cage, Max Monroe, Continuum, Scarlett Rose.

Scavenger
Destroying an enemy refills up to 30% (previously 20%) of your ammunition.
Available via the following Pilots: Marcus Shedd (Hero Pilot), Butch Savage, Salvo Sadie, “Lion” Wu.

Bio Repair
Whenever you lose shields, a random Module regenerates 4,000 (previously 2,000) armor per second for 2 seconds.
Available via the following Pilots: Ever (Hero Pilot), Evolve, Odyssey, Continuum, Ruin, Monarch, “Ratchet” Thompson.

Quick Reflexes
Activating any defensive Gear reduces shield cooldown by 25% for 15 seconds (previously 5).
Available via the following Pilots: Marcus Shedd (Hero Pilot), Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot), Scarlett O’Connor, Sarah Ali, Marcus, Davis, Leonardo Ricci, David Rodriguez.

Trigger-Happy
Boosts rate of fire by 4% (previously 6%).
Available via the following Pilots: Idy Demorest (Hero Pilot), “Veil” Silva, “Reaper” Williams, “Bullwork” Liu, “Watcher” Diop, “Lion” Wu, “Sloack” Wong, “Sentry” Cabrera.

Shield Preheater
Restores 800 more shield (previously 500) per second.
Available via the following Pilots: "Hammer" Petrova, "Fury" Vega, "Warden" Wu, "Pyro" Braun, "Chevalier" Dubois, "Mirage" Scott, "Drillbit" Ortiz.

Maximizer
For every 100,000 total damage (previously 200,000) you deal, instantly regenerates 20% of shield.
Available via the following Pilots: Idy Demorest (Hero Pilot), Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot), Scarlett O’Connor, “Fury” Vega, James Garcia, “Wild” Wilson, “Sentry” Cabrera.

Deflector Gizmo
After losing shields, reflect 20% of damage (previously 30%) back at the enemy for 5 seconds.
Available via the following Pilots: Kate Sinclair (Hero Pilot), Oracle.

Prizefighter
Destroying an enemy within 200m restores 7,500 armor (previously 10,000) to all modules.
Available via the following Pilots: Marcus Shedd (Hero Pilot), Sarah Nguyen.

Press The Attack
Damaging an enemy with your Gear boosts rate of fire by 15% (previously 30%) for 7 seconds.
Available via the following Pilots: "Drillbit" Ortiz

Field Repairs
Using Support Gear restores 4,000 armor (previously 2,000) to all damaged modules.
Available via the following Pilots: "Hammer" Petrova, Prodigy, Madam Jade, Continuum, James Garcia, Dusty Riley, Evolve, Scarlett Rose, Cyclone Joan, Brilliance, Ascendancy, Willow Flynn.

Bullet-Catcher
If any enemy is within 100m, you take 8% less damage (previously 6%). 
Available via the following Pilots: "Valkyrie" Vaughn, "Wraith" Parker, "Veil" Silva, Sneaky Sam, "Sentry" Cabrera, "Wild" Wilson, Allison Clay, Will Washington, "Chevalier" Dubois, Alex Cage, Judge Lancer, Monarch.

Siege Tower 
Staying still for 3 seconds (previously 5 seconds) adds 40,000 to your shields. Cancels on movement.
Available via the following Pilots: Eva Lambert, Odyssey, Leonardo Ricci, "Tempest" Gupta, "Reaper" Williams, Sadie Harrison, "Fury" Vega, "Watcher" Diop, "Rampart" Greco, "Stalker" Brown, Max Monroe, Aurora Singh.

Well-Timed
Staying still for 3 seconds (previously 5 seconds) boosts your weapon damage by 7%. Cancels on movement.
Available via the following Pilots: Echo, Marcus Davis, Salvo Sadie, "Lion" Wu, Prime, Ruin, "Warden" Wu, Dawn, Eloise Donovan, Scarlett O'Connor, Cascade, Jamal Jackson.
GameplayRespawn Buff
Players have highlighted that the Respawn buff currently grants an excessive advantage to highly skilled players, rendering them nearly invincible during its usage. While its intended purpose was to address spawn camping, we recognize that its offensive power when utilising long-range weaponry requires a relook. 

Responding to this feedback, we are making the following adjustments:
Removed the +50% damage buff after spawn on initial spawn points.Spawn points in Last Robot Standing have been moved further away from the map center.Removed the timer cooldown on additional spawn points in Last Robot Standing, making the spawn points available from the beginning.Balancing Playtest Rewards
Participants will receive a “Playtest Crew” Sticker, 4,000 Credits, and 40,000 Salvage for completing the in-game survey. Make sure you use the correct username and platform when completing the survey, as your rewards will be sent to that account. Your rewards will appear in the participating account by April 25.

                                                https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/04/198-BalancePTS/1.png
How To Download The Balancing PlaytestSteam
To get access to the War Robots: Frontiers Balancing Playtest on Steam, follow the instructions below:
If you have War Robots: Frontiers in your Steam Library, you will also own the licence for War Robots: Frontiers | Playtest. If you do not have War Robots: Frontiers in your Steam Library, head on over to the Store Page and click the “Play Game” button found on the Store Page.Navigate to War Robots: Frontiers | Playtest by searching for “War Robots: Frontiers” in your Library.Click "Install".After installation, you can press "Play" to participate in this Playtest.MY.GAMES LauncherClick War Robots: Frontiers Public Test Server to install the MY.GAMES Launcher and the appropriate playtest version.After installation is complete, check your library in MY.GAMES Launcher, and locate the "War Robots: Frontiers Public Test Server" project.Press "Play" to participate in the playtest.Feedback & Support
Join the official Discord server to make your voice heard about the Playtest. You can reach out to our Support team to report any issues you’re facing on the Wild Ten.

notes.title: Hero Pilot Spotlight: Idy “King” Demerost
notes.content:
Pilots are the final puzzle piece in your loadout, and choosing the ideal companion for your War Robot is critical to your success…or failure. 

Bow down to Idy “King” Demerost, a gentlemanly gunslinger on a mission to keep war as civilized as possible. 

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/04/197-Idyspotlight/1.png
BACKGROUND ANALYSISName: Idy DemerostCall Sign: KingClass: AssaultDominion: Freecon
Idy grew up on Mars as part of a group of Freecon settler families who were offered positions of authority on colonized outposts due to their reliability and traditional values. His father did not share Idy’s moral compass, and would often sacrifice other colonists for “the greater good”. Seeing this cruelty, Idy ran away to the Wild Ten at a young age, finding a new family in a band of mercenaries led by an old-school merc known as Ever who showed him the ropes.

During a mission, Idy’s code of conduct was put to the test. He lost an arm during a warp malfunction on the battlefield in an attempt to save a teammate. His squad gave him the call sign “King”, to demonstrate his leadership and sacrifice that day. Unfortunately, this also effectively ended his career as a Pilot.

After Idy was maimed, work was slow, and he was at a loose end back on Mars, hitting rock bottom. One day, there came an intriguing offer: an opportunity to return to his Pilot duties for a small favor...

King suddenly resurfaced on Tortuga, with his body rebuilt and his mind ready for action. Back in the driver’s seat, King takes his duties seriously, and will not engage in any type of criminality on or off the battlefield. He sees mercenary work as a noble profession, not a free pass to commit atrocities, and has made a number of enemies due to his belief in “gentlemanly warfare”. Heavy may be the head that wears the crown, but King’s unwavering honesty makes it feel lighter than air. 
TACTICAL TALENTS
Every Pilot has Talents, but it’s up to you to pick the best ones for battle. Pick one Talent per Rank, and give King free reign to cause some havoc.
Rank 1: General TalentsGearhead: Gear goes off cooldown faster.Case-Hardened: You take less damage from all sources.Feed Hacker: Your weapons reload quicker.Rank 2: Assault Talents (Class Specific)Gun Nut: Your autocannons and rocket launchers deal more damage.Maximizer: For every bit of damage you deal, instantly regenerate some shield.Offensive Tactics: Boosts primary and secondary stats of Attack Gear.Rank 3: Leader Talents (Personality Specific)Vanguard: If two or more allies are nearby, all of your Gear’s primary stats are boosted for a short while.Fire Support: If two or more allies are close by, your weapons deal more damage.It Takes Two: Assists boost your speed and mobility for a brief period. Rank 4: Freecon Talents (Dominion Specific)Gear Hacker: Boosts all of your Gear damage.Shield Preheater: Restores more shield per second.Trigger-Happy: Boosts rate of fire.Rank 5: Ace Talent 
Idy acquired this Talent through hard work and dedication.
Frontliner: Activating any Gear speeds you up.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes — April 8, 2025
notes.content:
Attention, Pilots! The following hotfix will be deployed for War Robots: Frontiers following a short period of maintenance on April 8, 2025.
Gameplay AdjustmentsProgression
Last week's Hotfix included an unlisted backend adjustment to expand the range of actions players could perform during Battle to earn Impact Points. While the average number of Impact Points per Battle was expected to remain unchanged, Credits earned during Battle were unintentionally reduced.

To address this issue, this week’s update increases the amount of Credits awarded for certain actions to restore balance and ensure a fair gameplay experience.
Balancing AdjustmentsGear
Core Gear: Blackout (Typhon)

We wanted to give players greater control over deciding the optimal moment to fire during combat encounters. As a result, we are adjusting how the lock-on and firing mechanics work for this Core Gear:
Homing missiles will no longer automatically fire upon target lock-on. New Mechanic: When pressing the Gear button, “Blackout” will lock-on to a target. Players need to press the “Fire” button to shoot the homing missiles towards their targeted enemy.General ImprovementsThe drop-down menu for muting or reporting a player in the Teams Interface now requires only a single click (previously required 2 clicks).Players are now shown a “Press T to Toggle Zoom” hint when switching aiming modes when aiming down right. The hint is displayed below the crosshair.Added a timer in the player HUD (bottom left next to Robot Health) that displays the remaining time of the 2X Damage Power-Up during Team Deathmatch.Improved overall performance and stability of the game.Technical ImprovementsImproved overall performance and stability of the game.Bug FixesFixed a bug where double the amount of acquired Experience was shown in the Battle Pass section of the Post Combat interface.Fixed a bug where names were occasionally not displayed in the Leaderboard.Fixed a bug in the Leaderboard where the name was not updated when a player changed their name.Fixed a bug where “Ghost Turret” would not be deployed where the player intended.Fixed a bug where “Ghost Turret” would occasionally not shoot at enemies.Fixed a bug where a debug sphere could become visible to the player when using Core Gear: Napalm Shell (Harpy).Fixed a bug where all projectiles would launch to the same place when using the Core Gear: Steel Feathers (Raven). The projectiles will now correctly fly to the location the player is actively aiming towards.Fixed a bug where the timers for Stickers and Paints in the Store did not display the correct end time.

notes.title: New Feature: Damage Debuffs Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Pilots on the Wild Ten have lots to contend with—gunfire, explosions, and even environmental damage, but we think you deserve even more mayhem. Have you ever been in the middle of fighting for a Warp Gate and started to get blurry vision or even get a warning to plug in your mech? No? Well, now you will! 

Introducing Pilot & War Robot Damage Debuffs, coming June 31! 

This new feature, known as Faulty Operational Overload Logic System (F.O.O.L.S), will add debuffs to your Pilot and War Robot, making battles even more realistic the more damage you take! 

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/04/192-F.O.O.L.S/Website_Body_1200x675.png
Vertigo
Battling in a War Robot can take its toll on even the hardiest of Pilots. Fight to stay in control with the new Vertigo debuff as it becomes harder and harder to stay on course!

[previewyoutube=IJBxkdaMfhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Concussion 
Shoot, dodge, jump! Wait…where am I? The new Concussion debuff adds all the fun of being utterly confused to the battlefield! 

[previewyoutube=oVK_N8SJyxE;full][/previewyoutube]
Low Battery
Did you forget to plug in your War Robot before bed again? The new Low Battery debuff adds technological realism to your battles, and reminds you to always leave the house with a spare portable charger.

notes.title: Hero Pilot Spotlight: Kate “Sparrow” Sinclair
notes.content:
Pilots are the final puzzle piece in your loadout, and choosing the ideal companion for your War Robot is critical to your success…or failure. 

Meet Kate “Sparrow” Sinclair, a grease monkey with a point to prove on the Wild Ten. 

https://static-eu.prod-my.games/chronos-public-eu-wrf-prod/site/2025/03/191-KateSpotlight/1.png
BACKGROUND ANALYSISName: Kate SinclairCall Sign: SparrowClass: AssaultDominion: Mayflower
Kate Sinclair led an idyllic life, but it was one without adventure. Through this boredom, she discovered modding, and it became a lifelong passion. Studying alone and breaking into the piloting world, quashing local rebellions soon became dull, and she longed for the real thing—warfare.

Kate is slowly but surely discovering that her dream of life on the Wild Ten is far from reality. This bright, talented mechanic is rarely found without a wrench in her hand, but her curiosity is often mistaken for naivety. While she isn’t street-smart, this rookie has a lot to prove and isn’t afraid to make mistakes along the way. Her blind enthusiasm is both her greatest weakness and her greatest strength.
TACTICAL TALENTS
Every Pilot has Talents, but it’s up to you to pick the best ones for battle. Pick one Talent per Rank, and put Kate through her paces.
Rank 1: General TalentsGearhead: Gear goes off cooldown faster.Case-Hardened: You take less damage from all sources.Feed Hacker: Your weapons reload quicker.Rank 2: Assault Talents (Class Specific)Gun Nut: Your autocannons and rocket launchers deal more damage.Maximizer: For every damage you deal, instantly regenerates some shield.Offensive Tactics: Boosts primary and secondary stats of Attack gear.Rank 3: Smart Talents (Personality Specific)Backup Plan: Whenever all your gear is on cooldown, activates a shield.Air Warrior: If you are in the air, deal more damage against armor.Synergist: Assists reduce cooldown of your gear.Rank 4: Mayflower Talents (Dominion Specific)Red Alert: Taking damage speeds up your weapon reload.Survival Instinct: If any Module has low armor, you take less damage from all sources.Quick Reflexes: Activating any defensive gear reduces shield cooldown.Rank 5: Ace Talent 
Kate acquired this Talent through hard work and dedication.
Deflector Gizmo: After losing shields, reflects damage back at the enemy.
